data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Your fund’s most recent 13F, for the period ending June 30, 2026, shows positions in MYFW, FRST, and COSO.

On August 31, 2026, FRST disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1325670/000110465926103947/tm2624389d1_8k.htm).

I publish an independent, public-records-only weekly issue and can offer a free copy plus a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
